items.title: Perioperative changes in liver biochemistry after general anaesthesia for non-hepatic surgery and the evidence for an association with anaesthetic duration: A narrative review
items.field: Anaesthesiology, Operation Theatre Technology, Perioperative Medicine, Clinical Biochemistry
items.description: This narrative review examines perioperative changes in liver biochemistry following general anaesthesia for non-hepatic surgery, with a particular focus on the potential association between anaesthetic duration and postoperative liver enzyme abnormalities. It explores the incidence, timing, possible mechanisms, clinical significance, contributing factors, and implications for perioperative patient care. The review also identifies current evidence gaps and priorities for future research.

items.title: Surgical Smoke Exposure in Operating Rooms: Health Risks, Occupational Protection and Emerging Smoke Evacuation Technologies
items.field: Anaesthesiology, Perioperative Medicine and Occupational Health
items.description: Surgical smoke from electrosurgery, lasers and ultrasonic devices contains toxic gases, ultrafine particles and viral DNA, and the whole operating room team breathes it in. Smoke evacuation is still rarely used in India, and there is no national guideline. This review covers the health risks, protection measures based on the hierarchy of controls, and emerging evacuation technologies, with practical recommendations for Indian hospitals.

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of Ventilator Alarm Systems in Commonly Used Mechanical Ventilators
items.description: This study comparatively evaluates the alarm systems of commonly used mechanical ventilators by analysing international standards, manufacturer documentation, and published clinical evidence.

items.title: Comparative Study of Dexmedetomidine and Propofol on Recovery Time After General Anaesthesia
items.field: Anaesthesia, OT Technology, Allied Health & Healthcare Researchers
